column1: The nutmeg tree, Myristica fragrans, is a large evergreen tree native to Southeast Asia.
column2: 肉豆蔻树，学名Myristica fragrans，是一种原产于东南亚的大型常绿乔木。

column1: Until the late 18th century, it only grew in one place in the world: a small group of islands in the Banda Sea, part of the Moluccas – or Spice Islands – in northeastern Indonesia.
column2: 直到18世纪晚期，它在全世界只生长于一个地方：班达海中的一小群岛屿。这些岛屿属于印度尼西亚东北部的摩鹿加群岛，也叫香料群岛。

column1: The tree is thickly branched with dense foliage of tough, dark green oval leaves, and produces small, yellow, bell-shaped flowers and pale yellow pear-shaped fruits.
column2: 肉豆蔻树枝条繁密，叶子厚韧，呈深绿色椭圆形。它开小巧的黄色钟形花，结淡黄色的梨形果实。

column1: The fruit is encased in a fleshy husk.
column2: 果实外包着一层肉质外果皮。

column1: When the fruit is ripe, this husk splits into two halves along a ridge running the length of the fruit.
column2: 果实成熟时，外皮就沿着贯穿整个果身的一道棱脊裂成两半。
column8: running the length of|沿……全长延伸

column1: Inside is a purple-brown shiny seed, 2–3 cm long by about 2 cm across, surrounded by a lacy red or crimson covering called an ‘aril’.
column2: 里面有一颗光亮的紫褐色种子，长2至3厘米，宽约2厘米。种子外包着一层红色或深红色的网状物，称为“假种皮”。

column1: These are the sources of the two spices nutmeg and mace, the former being produced from the dried seed and the latter from the aril.
column2: 种子和假种皮分别制成肉豆蔻和肉豆蔻衣这两种香料：前者来自干燥的种子，后者来自假种皮。

column1: Nutmeg was a highly prized and costly ingredient in European cuisine in the Middle Ages, and was used as a flavouring, medicinal, and preservative agent.
column2: 在中世纪的欧洲烹饪中，肉豆蔻是备受珍视而且昂贵的原料。人们用它调味、入药，也用它防腐。

column1: Throughout this period, the Arabs were the exclusive importers of the spice to Europe.
column2: 在这整个时期，只有阿拉伯人把这种香料输入欧洲。

column1: They sold nutmeg for high prices to merchants based in Venice, but they never revealed the exact location of the source of this extremely valuable commodity.
column2: 他们把肉豆蔻高价卖给以威尼斯为据点的商人，却始终没有透露这种极其贵重的商品究竟产自哪里。

column1: The Arab-Venetian dominance of the trade finally ended in 1512, when the Portuguese reached the Banda Islands and began exploiting its precious resources.
column2: 1512年，葡萄牙人抵达班达群岛，开始开发当地的珍贵资源，阿拉伯人和威尼斯人对这项贸易的主导地位才终于终结。
column3: Arab-Venetian|adj. 阿拉伯人与威尼斯人的

column1: Always in danger of competition from neighbouring Spain, the Portuguese began subcontracting their spice distribution to Dutch traders.
column2: 葡萄牙人始终面临邻国西班牙的竞争，于是开始把香料分销业务转包给荷兰商人。

column1: Profits began to flow into the Netherlands, and the Dutch commercial fleet swiftly grew into one of the largest in the world.
column2: 利润开始流入荷兰，荷兰商船队也迅速发展成为世界上最大的船队之一。

column1: The Dutch quietly gained control of most of the shipping and trading of spices in Northern Europe.
column2: 荷兰人悄然掌控了北欧大部分香料海运和交易。
column4: gained control of|取得对……的控制

column1: Then, in 1580, Portugal fell under Spanish rule, and by the end of the 16th century the Dutch found themselves locked out of the market.
column2: 随后，葡萄牙在1580年落入西班牙统治之下。到16世纪末，荷兰人发现自己已被排挤出这个市场。
column5: by the end of|到……末为止
column7: locked out of|被排挤在……之外

column1: As prices for pepper, nutmeg, and other spices soared across Europe, they decided to fight back.
column2: 随着胡椒、肉豆蔻和其他香料的价格在整个欧洲暴涨，荷兰人决定作出反击。

column1: In 1602, Dutch merchants founded the VOC, a trading corporation better known as the Dutch East India Company.
column2: 1602年，荷兰商人成立了VOC，这家贸易公司更为人熟知的名称是荷兰东印度公司。
column6: better known as|更为人熟知的名称是
column7: Dutch East India Company|荷兰东印度公司

column1: By 1617, the VOC was the richest commercial operation in the world.
column2: 到1617年，VOC已成为全球最富有的商业机构。

column1: The company had 50,000 employees worldwide, with a private army of 30,000 men and a fleet of 200 ships.
column2: 这家公司在全球有五万名员工，还拥有一支三万人的私人军队和一支由两百艘船组成的船队。

column1: At the same time, thousands of people across Europe were dying of the plague, a highly contagious and deadly disease.
column2: 与此同时，欧洲各地有成千上万的人死于鼠疫，这是一种传染性很强、可致人死亡的疾病。
column3: At the same time|与此同时

column1: Doctors were desperate for a way to stop the spread of this disease, and they decided nutmeg held the cure.
column2: 医生们急切地想找到阻止疫病蔓延的办法，而他们认定肉豆蔻就是解药。

column1: Everybody wanted nutmeg, and many were willing to spare no expense to have it.
column2: 人人都想得到肉豆蔻，许多人为此甘愿不惜重金。

column1: Nutmeg bought for a few pennies in Indonesia could be sold for 68,000 times its original cost on the streets of London.
column2: 在印度尼西亚花几个便士买到的肉豆蔻，在伦敦街头可以卖到原价的六万八千倍。
column8: on the streets of|在……的街头

column1: The only problem was the short supply.
column2: 唯一的问题是供货不足。

column1: And that’s where the Dutch found their opportunity.
column2: 荷兰人正是从这一点中看到了机会。

column1: The Banda Islands were ruled by local sultans who insisted on maintaining a neutral trading policy towards foreign powers.
column2: 班达群岛由当地苏丹统治，他们坚持在同外国势力经商时保持中立。
column7: neutral trading policy|中立的贸易政策

column1: This allowed them to avoid the presence of Portuguese or Spanish troops on their soil, but it also left them unprotected from other invaders.
column2: 这一政策使他们避免了葡萄牙或西班牙军队驻扎在自己的土地上，却也让他们在其他入侵者面前缺乏保护。
column6: on their soil|在自己的国土上

column1: In 1621, the Dutch arrived and took over.
column2: 1621年，荷兰人来到群岛，接管了当地的统治。

column1: Once securely in control of the Bandas, the Dutch went to work protecting their new investment.
column2: 牢牢掌控班达群岛之后，荷兰人便着手保护自己的新投资。

column1: They concentrated all nutmeg production into a few easily guarded areas, uprooting and destroying any trees outside the plantation zones.
column2: 他们把肉豆蔻的生产集中在少数容易看守的地区，将种植园以外的肉豆蔻树全都连根拔除、摧毁。

column1: Anyone caught growing a nutmeg seedling or carrying seeds without the proper authority was severely punished.
column2: 凡未经许可培育肉豆蔻幼苗或携带种子的人，一经发现便会受到严惩。

column1: In addition, all exported nutmeg was covered with lime to make sure there was no chance a fertile seed which could be grown elsewhere would leave the islands.
column2: 此外，所有出口的肉豆蔻都要裹上石灰，以确保任何能够在外地种植的活种子都不会流出群岛。
column8: fertile seed|有发芽能力的种子

column1: There was only one obstacle to Dutch domination.
column2: 荷兰人的垄断只剩下一项障碍。

column1: One of the Banda Islands, a sliver of land called Run, only 3 km long by less than 1 km wide, was under the control of the British.
column2: 班达群岛中有一座叫伦岛的狭长小岛，长仅3公里，宽不足1公里，由英国人控制。
column3: sliver of land|狭长的一小块土地
column6: under the control of|在……的控制之下

column1: After decades of fighting for control of this tiny island, the Dutch and British arrived at a compromise settlement, the Treaty of Breda, in 1667.
column2: 荷英为争夺这座小岛相持数十年后，于1667年达成妥协协议，即《布雷达条约》。

column1: Intent on securing their hold over every nutmeg-producing island, the Dutch offered a trade: if the British would give them the island of Run, they would in turn give Britain a distant and much less valuable island in North America.
column2: 荷兰人一心想牢牢控制每座出产肉豆蔻的岛屿，于是提出了一笔交换：如果英国把伦岛交给荷兰，荷兰就把北美一座遥远且价值低得多的岛屿交给英国。

column1: The British agreed.
column2: 英国人同意了。

column1: That other island was Manhattan, which is how New Amsterdam became New York.
column2: 交换的那座岛就是曼哈顿；新阿姆斯特丹也因此变成了纽约。

column1: The Dutch now had a monopoly over the nutmeg trade which would last for another century.
column2: 如今，荷兰人垄断了肉豆蔻贸易，这种局面后来又持续了一个世纪。

column1: Then, in 1770, a Frenchman named Pierre Poivre successfully smuggled nutmeg plants to safety in Mauritius, an island off the coast of Africa.
column2: 后来，在1770年，一位名叫皮埃尔·普瓦夫尔的法国人成功地把肉豆蔻植株秘密运到了安全之地——非洲沿海的毛里求斯岛。

column1: Some of these were later exported to the Caribbean where they thrived, especially on the island of Grenada.
column2: 后来，其中一些植株被运往加勒比地区，在那里长得十分繁茂，在格林纳达岛尤其如此。

column1: Next, in 1778, a volcanic eruption in the Banda region caused a tsunami that wiped out half the nutmeg groves.
column2: 接着，在1778年，班达地区发生火山喷发，引发海啸，毁掉了一半的肉豆蔻林。

column1: Finally, in 1809, the British returned to Indonesia and seized the Banda Islands by force.
column2: 最后，1809年英国人重返印度尼西亚，以武力夺取了班达群岛。

column1: They returned the islands to the Dutch in 1817, but not before transplanting hundreds of nutmeg seedlings to plantations in several locations across southern Asia.
column2: 1817年，英国人将这些岛屿归还给荷兰，但在此之前，他们已经把数百株肉豆蔻幼苗移栽到亚洲南部多处种植园中。

column1: The Dutch nutmeg monopoly was over.
column2: 荷兰人对肉豆蔻的垄断结束了。

column1: Today, nutmeg is grown in Indonesia, the Caribbean, India, Malaysia, Papua New Guinea and Sri Lanka, and world nutmeg production is estimated to average between 10,000 and 12,000 tonnes per year.
column2: 今天，印度尼西亚、加勒比地区、印度、马来西亚、巴布亚新几内亚和斯里兰卡都有肉豆蔻种植。据估计，全球肉豆蔻产量平均每年在一万至一万二千吨之间。
column6: Papua New Guinea|巴布亚新几内亚
